name: Shell release, bead capture, ethanol wash and elution chip
description: Digests the capsule shells to release cDNA, then binds the library to magnetic beads, washes them with ethanol on the magnet and elutes in water. Parametric parts: modules release_trap, beads_1 use the nearest library block as a stand-in (real part and sizing in autochip_part / params). build_chip.py builds the stand-ins at library size; the exact chip needs the autochip layout stage.
source: autochip chip plan spc_capsule_workflow_resin_print_multilayer (protocol spc_capsule_workflow, constraints resin_print_multilayer)

modules.does: Holds the capsules while the shell-digesting enzyme dissolves the shells and releases the cDNA, which leaves through the main line.
Beads bind the library, are held over the magnet during ethanol washes, and the library is then eluted in water.

off_chip.why: Library concentration and size measurement is done on the bench; the lab has no fluorometer in its list, so it is a manual step on the eluted sample.

steps_text.22: Release the cDNA by digesting the capsule shells with a shell-digesting enzyme.
steps_text.23: Bind the library to magnetic beads.
steps_text.24: Wash the beads with ethanol wash solution on a magnet.
steps_text.25: Elute the library from the beads in water.
